sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Head of the alate dark brown, oval, densely covered with fairly long hairs; fontanelle small and conspicuous, with two large muscle attachment scars in front of the ocelli; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 extremely small, segment 4 shorter than segment 2; compound eyes moderate, not particularly close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli rather small, about their own length from the compound eye or closer; pronotum with a Y-shaped mark in the middle, the stalk pale and the two arms dark. Closest to A. ater Hagen, but smaller in its measurements.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval, densely covered with fairly long hairs. Fontanelle small and conspicuous. In front of the ocelli two large muscle attachment scars. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 extremely small, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Compound eyes moderate, not particularly close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli rather small, about their own length from the compound eye or shorter. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, with a median line. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, with a Y-shaped mark in the middle, the stalk pale and the two arms dark; the sides rounded, the posterior margin very shallowly concave. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum narrow and deeply concave. Wings pale smoky in alcohol, the veins indistinct near the apex; in some specimens the veins are clearer, with a network between the radius and the media; in life the wings are blue-grey. Abdominal tergites about the same colour as the pronotum. Measurements (male/female): body length with wings 8.00—8.50/9.50—10.00 mm, body length without wings 4.50—5.00/5.50—6.00 mm; head length 0.90—0.93/0.97—1.06 mm, head width 0.77—0.83/0.82—0.90 mm; antennal length 1.40—1.50 mm (female); compound eye diameter 0.20—0.21/0.23 mm; pronotum length 0.43—0.46/0.46—0.48 mm, width 0.60—0.70/0.71—0.73 mm; hind tibia length 0.83—0.97/0.91—0.94 mm; forewing length 7.00—7.26/7.95—8.00 mm, width 1.67—1.73/1.90—1.95 mm; queen body length 25.00 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; known only from the type locality. Holotype an alate. The description is based on the many alates, dealate males and queens collected by the author in eight different nests at Kartabo. The specific name honours the American entomologist Nathan Banks.
